The pleasant texture and flavor of snails combine with butter and milk in a rich soup.|Recipe Book|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Clam Chowder|Clam Chowders|BotW|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Clam Chowder}}
The nutritional value of hearty blueshell snail combines with butter and milk in a rich soup.|Inventory|BotW}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Clam Chowder is a dish made by [[Cooking]] [[Fresh Milk]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], and a [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their regular version can only be made by including a fifth ingredient with an effect that contradicts that of the Hearty Blueshell Snail. If eaten, they will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The nutritious Hearty Blueshell Snails combine with the other ingredients to create a rich soup. There is only one variation of Clam Chowder that can be made: * '''Hearty Clam Chowder''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Clam Chowder}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The nutritional value of hearty blueshell snail combines with butter and milk in a rich soup.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using the default recipe. Eating this chowder will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Snail Chowder is a [[Meal]] made by [[Cooking]] a [[Sneaky River Snail]], [[Fresh Milk]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Tabantha Wheat]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Ashai House Poster.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The recipe for Hearty Clam Chowder, hung up in Ashai's house ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood, Soups |items= TotK }}
